scope: Bounded closure of the 129 original P99-zone sources assigned from the unmapped_trade_no_literal_reward_calls_requires_inspection category. This is complete-source trade-surface classification, not full dialogue/wiki parity or a new quest proposal.

inspection.method: Read every complete unique source, bind each exact-key record to the full-file hash, inspect all handlers and top-level context, then require exact structural matches for every event_trade. Independent read-only second inspection agreed on all bodies and eight non-trade progression/lifecycle cases.

inputDependencies.note: return_items delegates only to NPC ReturnHandinItems; no current items-module proposal override was found.
ReturnHandinItems is a compatibility no-op. The source-level refund classification means no offer consumption, not a tested inventory settlement.
Trade service calculates consumption from remaining CurrentTrade item/currency values; inspected for context only, not executed.
plugin.soulbinder_say records hail text or a typed Bind request; no hidden item/quest progression helper.
Reached signal body only emits emote/text; the complete actor is disabled and its other event chain is not re-audited.
Existing focused source dispositions checked for exact/related progression coverage.
Existing manual event dispositions checked for related Gimlik tracker context.
Existing Scout Blade and Shaman Skull family coverage checked without inflating it to exact actor review.
Current page ledger inspected for related family scope and exclusion coverage.
Exact effective-source mapping and preferred-source provenance.
Current merged signal receiver only speaks stage approval; all other receiver branches are outside this bounded dependency check.

limits: Absence of literal reward calls is not used as proof of no quest behavior. All 129 trade handlers are refund-only, but eight sources retain real non-trade progression/lifecycle surfaces.
Ten bind-service sources, two combat-flavor sources and three ambient-callback sources are not described as inert. Nine hint/conditional-dialogue sources retain explicit uncertainty.
An exact source/key/hash match is required to reuse a record. A source changed after this inspection must be re-evaluated.
Related quest/family artifacts do not certify omitted exact actor callbacks. Current page references and NPC name matches are navigation aids, not runtime identity or admission proof.
No Lua, proposal, baseline, enabled state, harmless flavor or world script was modified. No compile/VM/game/database/UI/connected-chain test was run for this documentation-only classification.
Existing cache pages are historical snapshots. Sparse NPC-page related-quest fields and cache absence do not prove that a quest is absent.
Only the two immediately reached signal receivers and shared refund/binding helpers were inspected as dependencies; their full independent quest families were not added to the assignment.
